questions.question: In the Nebraska canal study, when did diversions typically occur, and when were empty canals intermittently repaired?
required_facts: Diversions into the unlined canals typically occurred from May through September.
The empty canals were intermittently repaired from October through April.
forbidden_claims: Diversions typically occurred from October to April
questions.manual_evidence_note: Manually checked against fs11503.pdf physical page 2; the two seasonal clauses are consecutive source text and cross the fixed-window evidence boundary.

questions.question: At the Presidio of Monterey site, how deep did rippable material extend beneath Line A and Line B?
required_facts: Line A had rippable material to at least 30 ft depth.
Line B had rippable material to a minimum of 18 to 20 ft depth.
forbidden_claims: Line A and Line B both extended to 30 ft
questions.manual_evidence_note: Manually checked against OF12-1191.pdf physical page 17, Conclusions; the two depths are tied to different survey lines.

questions.question: Why can SH-wave refraction fail to reveal a lower-velocity layer, and what thickness-related limitation also applies?
required_facts: Refraction cannot reliably detect velocity reversals because it assumes layer velocities increase with depth.
A layer must have a minimum thickness to be identified, known as the blind-zone or hidden-layer problem.
forbidden_claims: SH-wave refraction reliably detects all velocity reversals
questions.manual_evidence_note: Manually checked against s10950-021-10042-z.pdf physical page 3; both limitations appear in the numbered discussion of shallow refraction limits.

questions.question: What field setup is required to analyze a dipping seismic-refraction boundary for a single array?
required_facts: The refraction profile must be reversed.
At least two shots must be fired, one from each end of the array.
forbidden_claims: A single shot from the array midpoint is sufficient
questions.manual_evidence_note: Manually checked against twri_2-d2.pdf physical page 14 under Two-layer dipping-boundary formulas.

questions.question: What is the title of the 2021 paper about shear-wave reflection and refraction methods?
questions.manual_evidence_note: Manually checked the manifest and paper title page: the target title belongs only to geo-s10950-021-10042-z, whose document_type is paper and is excluded by the report filter.

questions.question: What exact annual maintenance budget did the controlled seismic surveys require?
questions.manual_evidence_note: Manual review of the six controlled PDFs found no exact annual maintenance budget for controlled seismic surveys; this is intentionally unanswerable rather than an excluded-source question.
